key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A572
name: return_void_routine
description: Does nothing: its body is a bare return, so calling it has no effect. Two other unnamed routines call it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A662
name: clear_buffer_from_pointer
description: Stores a pointer taken from a global variable into a fixed slot of a global structure, then zeroes a fixed-length run of bytes starting at that pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A674
name: clear_flagged_table_entries
description: Zeroes a counter field, then walks a byte table from its last index downward, clearing each entry whose bit 32 is set and stopping at the start of the table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A696
name: clear_entry_and_decrement
description: Reads a table index from its input, decrements a counter if that entry has bit 32 set, then clears the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A6BA
name: call_clear_entry_decrement
description: Calls one called routine routine with no arguments and returns, adding no logic of its own.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A6C4
name: dispatch_flagged_handlers_then_clear
description: Reads a table index from its input. If that entry's bit 32 is clear, it calls the method at offset 48 of each list slot whose bit 4 is set, then clears the entry; otherwise it decrements the counter and clears the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A710
name: update_object_state_and_totals
description: Calls the method at offset 48 of each flagged list slot, then checks a table flag and a per-object value; on the counter-exhausted path it adds a table value to a running total and calls a function pointer. Returns 1 when the table flag is set or the entry value is zero, otherwise 0.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A7CE
name: call_function_pointer
description: Calls the function pointer stored at a fixed offset in the global structure, then returns a 64-bit value with 1 in the high half and the register input in the low half.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A7E6
name: call_pointer_and_mark_status
description: Calls a global function pointer, sets bit 1 in a status byte of the input object, and if the object's type field is -1 calls a second global pointer. Returns 1.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A800
name: process_object_state
description: Checks a flag on the input object against a global key and, on a match, invokes a callback and updates a per-object counter. It then calls a handler on the object, adjusts totals and timers, and returns 0.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A99A
name: return_first_stack_argument
description: Returns the 32-bit value passed on the stack as its first argument, with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2A9A0
name: init_object_and_accumulate_fields
description: Stores a value into a field of the object, sets several state bytes, adds two shifted callback results to three accumulator fields of a second object, then returns the result of a final callback.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AA0A
name: classify_value_and_update_totals
description: Reads a 16-bit value from a callback and sorts it into ranges: each range adds a table bonus to running totals or clears a per-slot entry. Flagged objects get a callback at the end.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AA5A
name: extract_flag_from_mask
description: Repeatedly calls a function pointer to get a bit index until it finds a bit set in the object's mask, then moves that bit from the mask into a second mask field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AAAC
name: apply_value_range_bonus
description: Classifies a 16-bit input value into ranges: low values add a table bonus to three totals and clear a flag byte, a middle range adds a reduced bonus, and high values clear a per-slot entry. Calls a callback on flagged objects and returns 1.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AAE6
name: clear_flag_add_bonus
description: Reads a byte index from the object, clears that byte and a 4-byte field, then adds a table value to three totals if the object is flagged and calls a callback.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AB1A
name: add_indexed_bonus_to_totals
description: If the object's byte index is non-zero, marks it as 1 and, when the object is flagged, adds a table value reduced by 4 to three totals. Flagged objects then get a callback, and the routine returns 1.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AB50
name: bucket_value_and_count
description: Compares an input value with a total; when it is below the total, it scans a 30-entry threshold table for the matching bracket, decrements that bucket and increments a counter, then calls a callback on flagged objects. Returns 1.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AB84
name: update_speed_and_timers
description: Moves a speed field toward its target by a scaled step, clamps a second field, decays timer bytes and a counter, then computes a scaled magnitude from three signed fields. It subtracts that magnitude from a budget field and returns it, or resets related fields and calls a callback when the budget is spent.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AC6E
name: refill_budget_and_callback
description: Subtracts an input amount from a budget field and returns while budget remains. When it is exhausted, it resets the budget, then either refills it from a counter or calls a callback, and clears three status fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2ACA8
name: refill_from_counter_or_callback
description: If a short counter is non-zero, decrements it, increments a second counter and adds a refill to the object's budget. Otherwise it sets a flag and calls a callback when the flag was clear, then clears three fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2ACB8
name: refill_budget_or_clear_fields
description: If a byte counter is non-zero, decrements it and adds a refill to the budget field and returns; otherwise it clears three fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2ACD0
name: set_flag_and_call_handler
description: Sets bit 1 in a global flag byte and, if that bit was previously clear, calls a function pointer from a global table. Then it clears three 32-bit fields of the object.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AD02
name: reload_timer_and_apply_bonus
description: Subtracts an input amount from a 32-bit timer; when it wraps, reloads it with a fixed constant, decrements two short counters and compares a called routine's value against them. A passing check applies a table bonus to three totals before a callback runs.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AD0A
name: reload_timer_and_check_counters
description: Reloads a 32-bit timer with a fixed constant, decrements two short counters and compares a called routine's value against them. When the check passes, it applies a table bonus to three totals and calls a callback.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AD42
name: apply_pending_bonus_and_callback
description: If the object's byte index is non-zero, clears it and a 4-byte field, adds a table bonus to three totals, then calls a callback.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AD76
name: check_value_and_apply_bonus
description: Calls a called routine to get a value; if its low byte is not above a counter, it applies the table bonus for the object's byte index to three totals and calls a callback. Otherwise it returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:5:2AD7C
name: conditional_bonus_and_callback
description: Calls two routines; when the comparison flag from the first is set, it applies a table bonus to three totals based on the second value. It always calls a callback at the end.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0000
name: store_value_and_notify_slot
description: Stores the 16-bit input in a field of the object; if a previously stored slot index is non-zero, it calls the method at offset 36 of that slot with the value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0014
name: store_input_word
description: Stores the 16-bit input word into a field at offset 6 of the object.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:001A
name: lookup_scaled_table_value
description: Turns a 32-bit input into a table index by shifting its bits in one of several ranges, then reads a 16-bit value from the global table and returns it shifted right by a range-dependent amount.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0390
name: initialize_object_fields
description: Initializes an object structure: clears a 16-bit field, writes two fixed constant words, fills several slots with handler and table pointers, then sets a length field and loops over a range of entries, calling routines as it goes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0464
name: initialize_and_iterate_table
description: Sets two fixed sentinel words when the input is below a threshold, clears a field and sets two accumulator fields, then repeatedly calls a handler from each table entry until a byte counter reaches its limit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:04CC
name: process_timer_and_flagged_handlers
description: Clears flag bits, calls a handler for each active slot, and when a 32-bit timer passes a fixed period calls a second handler on slots with bit 1 set, passing the number of periods. Finally it scans a byte table backward, calling a handler for each entry with bit 2 set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0548
name: call_handler_if_active
description: Calls the method at offset 20 of each slot whose active byte is non-zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:056A
name: dispatch_slot_by_key
description: When a flag bit is clear, it obtains a key from a called routine and searches the slot keys for a match. On a match it calls the method at offset 8 of that slot; otherwise it calls a default method at offset 48.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:05A2
name: call_handler_by_bit_mask
description: Maps the input code to one of several bit positions through fixed comparisons, then calls the method at offset 12 of each slot whose flag byte has that bit set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:05EE
name: update_pseudo_random_state
description: Updates two 32-bit state words with shifts, an XOR against a constant and an addition, advancing a pseudo-random sequence.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:060A
name: compute_scaled_random_value
description: Advances the two state words, then multiplies the low word of the input by the high half of the new state and returns that product.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:062C
name: scale_input_by_state
description: Multiplies the low word of the input by a value derived from a state word and the second input, returning the scaled product.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:063C
name: negate_64_bit_value
description: Calls a called routine for a 64-bit value and returns its two's complement negation, carrying between the two halves.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0648
name: multiply_fixed_point_64
description: Subtracts two 64-bit operands and, when the result is non-negative, multiplies it by a 32-bit factor using 16-bit partial products; otherwise it returns a called routine's value negated. The result is a 64-bit value with status bits.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:064E
name: perform_32x32_multiplication
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values from 16-bit partial products with carry handling, returning a 64-bit result with status bits in the high word.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:06AE
name: build_scaled_vector_fields
description: Takes two called routine results to set three difference fields in the object, multiplies them by a scale, and writes six 32-bit vector components shifted according to an exponent input.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:072E
name: store_shifted_vector_components
description: Stores three input values as vector components, then shifts three further components left by the exponent minus one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0738
name: accumulate_scaled_vector
description: Scales three short fields of the object by a factor from the input, then adds the resulting 32-bit values into three accumulator pairs with carry propagation.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0796
name: normalize_and_double_result
description: Counts the right shifts needed to reduce the input to zero, calls a called routine for a 64-bit value and shifts that value left by the same count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:07BE
name: normalize_input_and_shift_result
description: Right-shifts the input until it is at most 32767, counting the shifts, then calls a called routine and shifts its 64-bit result left by that count.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:07D2
name: negate_64bit_result
description: Calls a called routine and returns its 64-bit result negated in two's complement.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:07E6
name: multiply_fixed_point_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit fixed-point operands from register inputs using 16-bit partial products and a shift. Negative operands are negated through a called routine call, and large operands are shifted down before the called routine runs.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:07EA
name: normalize_and_multiply_fixed
description: Shifts its input down until it fits a 16-bit range, multiplies it by a second 32-bit operand with 16-bit partial products, then shifts the 64-bit result left by the number of bits removed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:07EC
name: multiply_by_scaled_input
description: Shifts the input down by seven bits. If the result is still at least 32768 it shifts further, calls another routine and shifts that result left; otherwise it multiplies the scaled value by a 32-bit operand using 16-bit partial products.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:07F6
name: multiply_pair_by_short_factor
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values from register inputs by a 16-bit factor using partial products with carries, then shifts each 64-bit product right by one bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0854
name: add_64bit_to_accumulator
description: Adds a 64-bit result from another routine into three 32-bit accumulator words, then adds two stored input words and carries into the next three words of the object.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0882
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:08A8
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:08CE
name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns, with no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:08F4
name: fetch_table_entry
description: Returns the 16-bit value at the byte offset given by the input word, measured from the base pointer stored in a global table pointer.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0906
name: store_two_table_pointers
description: Stores two 32-bit input values into two pointer fields of the global structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0910
name: reset_table_pointers
description: Points two pointer fields of the global structure at the shared global data block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0922
name: record_first_index_and_advance
description: When the byte at the given index is zero and the write cursor is below a fixed limit, it stores the cursor there, writes a 32-bit index record at the cursor, and advances the cursor by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:093C
name: write_index_record_if_space
description: When the write cursor is below a fixed limit, writes a 32-bit index record at the cursor and advances the cursor by four; otherwise it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:094E
name: write_byte_and_index
description: Stores the low byte of the second input at the offset given by the first input, writes a combined 32-bit index record after that position, and advances the cursor by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0962
name: return_without_work
description: Empty routine that only returns; nothing is stored or called.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:096E
name: clip_pair_bounds_then_call
description: Checks two input pairs against bounds of 319 and 167, returning early when a value is out of range; when both pairs pass it calls one other routine and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0986
name: forward_to_one_routine
description: Calls one other routine and returns, adding no logic of its own.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0996
name: check_bounds_then_call
description: Returns early when the first input pair exceeds bounds of 319 and 167 or the second pair does, after a second routine is consulted for each pair; otherwise it calls one other routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:09AA
name: check_point_bounds_then_call
description: Returns early unless a pair of input values lies within bounds of 319 and 167, then calls one other routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:09C2
name: set_timer_flags_on_bit
description: Checks status bit 128 of the object and, when it is set, sets flag bit 8 in a global byte. Either branch then sets flag bit 4 in that byte, sets a countdown byte to 2 and clears bit 64 in the object's flags before calling another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:09D4
name: set_flags_and_call
description: Sets flag bits 8 and 4 in a global byte, sets a countdown byte to 2 in the object, sets bit 32 and clears bit 64 in the object's flags, then calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0A06
name: set_flag_and_call
description: Sets flag bit 4 in a global byte, sets a countdown byte to 2 in the object, sets bit 32 and clears bit 64 in the object's flags, then calls another routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0A32
name: clear_flag_and_extend_timer
description: If the object's bit 1024 is set, clears it and increases a short counter by 4, either a global one or a field of the object. It then sets a countdown byte to 7, updates flag bits, calls another routine and sets global bit 16.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0A3E
name: store_flags_and_extend_timer
description: Stores the input as the object's flag word and increases a short counter by 4, either a global one or an object field. It then sets a countdown byte to 7, updates flag bits, calls another routine and sets global bit 16.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0A50
name: set_object_state_and_flags
description: Increases an object counter by 4, sets a countdown byte to 7, updates flag bits, calls two other routines in sequence and sets global bit 16.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0A8E
name: check_range_then_call
description: When the object's 16-bit index is below 79 and differs from the second object, it calls another routine. If the input value is below 18, it then calls a further routine.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0ABC
name: select_offsets_and_update_budget
description: Selects one of several table offset pairs from the input index, scales them by the object's fields and stores the result, then adds a budget increment from a table and calls routines. Its alternate branch copies six accumulator words from a global block for a counted number of passes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0C12
name: add_budget_from_table
description: Chooses an increment from a table using bits of a state byte, adds it to the object's budget field with saturation, sets a limit word, and returns a called routine's result shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0C6E
name: add_scaled_budget_increment
description: Multiplies the input by a scaled field, shifts it by a table value, adds the result to the object's budget field with saturation, and returns a called routine's result shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr flt][a]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr FLT][a].adf:Frontier:6:0CB8
